calculation.expression: -(sum_return(close,5) / rolling_std(daily_return(close),20)) when downside_breadth_5d > 0.60 and median_abs_5d_return > 0.003, else missing
calculation.description: Contrarian risk-adjusted five-day return. It is active only when more than 60% of tradable assets have negative five-day returns and the cross-asset median absolute five-day move exceeds 0.3%. Positive scores indicate assets expected to rebound after broad downside stress.
